About GIPS
AGES 1–6 — Najjera, Kampala
About Gill Pre-School

High‑quality, Christ‑centred early learning

Gill International Pre‑School (GIPS) is an early childhood centre for children aged 1–6 years, blending local and international teaching methods so each child realises their full potential — creative, confident, successful and independent.

01

Our Mission

To support the needs of children with sensitivity and affection, fostering the holistic development of character and unique abilities.

02

Our Vision

To provide children with high quality, Christ‑centred early learning that develops their full potential.

03

Our Promise

Small classes of 20, warm qualified teachers and a seamless path into Gill International School.
